title: Titanium Ultrasonic Rotary Horn
function: Monobloc ultrasonic rotary horn core for continuous seal
alloyReason: Triaxially forged Titanium Ultrasonic Rotary Horn (UNS R56400) is specified for this ultrasonic tooling component where isotropic mechanical properties are mandatory for withstanding multi-axial stress states. The 3D forging process eliminates crystallographic texture directionality, delivering uniform 950 MPa tensile strength and >15% elongation in all three orientations. This is critical for Monobloc ultrasonic rotary horn core for continuous seal where fatigue crack initiation is sensitive to microstructural anisotropy. This rationale is driven by monobloc ultrasonic rotary horn core for continuous seal and specific design requirements.
process: CNC turn-mill multi-axis for ultrasonic tooling geometry
Shot peening Almen at 200W fiber laser
Black oxide/DLC coating at 200W fiber laser
CMM SPC dimensional check at 200W fiber laser
surfaceTreatment: DLC coating 2um, 15GPa hardness, 0.1mu friction coefficient applied to wear surfaces for extended durability — tailored for monobloc ultrasonic rotary application
commonFailures: Fatigue crack at thread-shank transition - prevented by larger fillet R0.5->1.5mm + cold rolling — critical for monobloc ultrasonic rotary performance

faq.q: What weight-to-strength ratio does Titanium Ultrasonic Rotary Horn offer over steel?
faq.a: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V provides 40-45% weight reduction versus 4130/4340 steel at equivalent strength: 4.43 g/cm³ vs 7.85 g/cm³ with 830 MPa yield. For monobloc ultrasonic rotary, this translates directly to reduced unsprung mass (suspension) or reduced reciprocating mass (valvetrain), improving both acceleration response and fatigue-limited component life by 2-3×.

faq.q: What is the typical lead time for Titanium Ultrasonic Rotary Horn orders?
faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium Ultrasonic Rotary Horn is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Ultrasonic Rotary Horn?
faq.a: Each Titanium Ultrasonic Rotary Horn shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for monobloc ultrasonic rotary.
